question.prompt: The radius of \(\odot O\) is \(5\). Chord \(AB\parallel\) chord \(CD\), \(AB=6\), and \(CD=8\). The two chords lie on opposite sides of the center \(O\). Find the distance between \(AB\) and \(CD\).

solutions.explanation: The distance from the center to \(AB\) is \(\sqrt{25-9}=4\), and the distance from the center to \(CD\) is \(\sqrt{25-16}=3\). Since the two chords lie on opposite sides of the center, the distance between them is \(4+3=7\).
solutions.title: Add the two perpendicular distances
